notes: NO MAKER SOURCE: radioflyer.com/products/flyer-via returns 404 and the Flyer Via is not in Radio Flyer's product catalog or eBike landing page (only Flyer Loop and Flyer Via Pro). Likely discontinued, but no maker page says so. Used dealer eBike Super Shop (authorized Flyer dealer page) and The Gadgeteer's June 2024 review. Gadgeteer lists '+/-' as 'Class 1, 20mph limitation' in its cons but calls it Class 2 in the body. Used 1 WebSearch. Recheck: radioflyer.com/products/flyer-via is now a 404 and the maker's search shows only the Via Pro (likely discontinued, not stated). Found Radio Flyer's own FLYER VIA spec sheet PDF (images.radioflyer.com/media/flyer/specs/884.pdf, by trying neighbouring spec-sheet numbers to the Via Pro's 886; SKU 884 matches the old product page) with rider heights; it gives no price or range. One web search; Cycling Weekly launch story and Top5ebikes review both give the $2,199 launch price (site shows $1,599, likely a later markdown) and 30-50+ / up to 50 miles range. Source given by Chris: ridereview.com/products/radio-flyer-via (review site, 'Radio Flyer Via eBike Review', release year 2024). Stock: not a seller, no stock/for-sale status shown; it only links 'Buy at Radio Flyer' (affiliate link to flyer.radioflyer.com/products/flyer-via, not opened). Review mentions the Via Pro upgrade ('a more powerful 750-watt motor'); recorded specs are the base Via's table.
